_what: Shared conformance vectors for agent-control adapters (WQ-480). Every host's adapter must produce these verdicts from these inputs.
_why: One policy file stops two adapters DISAGREEING about the data. It does not stop them disagreeing about the semantics - which rule wins, what counts as an ask, whether prose about a command is a request to run it. Those are the decisions that made this control usable rather than muted, and an adapter that got them subtly wrong would look installed and pass its own tests. So the semantics live here as data too, and each adapter is measured against the same cases instead of trusted.
_how_to_use: pack/scripts/verify-audit-behavior.ps1 step 83 runs the Cursor PowerShell adapters against every case. An adapter for another host - an OpenCode plugin, a CLI wrapper - is not finished until it passes this same file. That is the difference between porting a control and rewriting one.

_verdict_vocabulary.flag:offload: The ask names a command the agent is obliged to run itself.
_verdict_vocabulary.flag:settled: The ask re-raises a decision the owner already made and recorded.
_verdict_vocabulary.clean: Nothing to act on. The turn stands exactly as written.
_verdict_vocabulary.no-opinion: Say nothing and leave normal review in place.
